headline: You build data pipelines in deliberate steps, asking tests to prove correctness and privacy rules to survive the journey to the mart.

archetype.name: The Pipeline Gatekeeper
archetype.description: You approach data engineering as a sequence of checks: clarify the design, demonstrate a failure, implement the change, and inspect what remains uncovered. Your prompts connect Python ingestion, dbt modeling, and Dagster orchestration with recurring attention to precision, reproducibility, and customer-data protection. You keep the conversation short while making acceptance criteria surprisingly specific.

dimensions.title: Small steps, visible proof
dimensions.summary: You often separate design, verification, and implementation into reviewable steps. Test-first requests recur across ingestion, assets, and modeling, and you ask for measured bottlenecks before changing performance-sensitive code.

evidence.quote: test 先跑一次確認會 fail，我想看到 red 再改 code
先寫 test 再寫 asset，這是我的習慣，麻煩照這個順序
週末想把 ledger-etl 的 test 速度改善，現在跑一次要 40 秒，先幫我找出最慢的 test
先設計不要寫 code

dimensions.title: Brief requests, precise boundaries
dimensions.summary: You usually write concise Traditional Chinese with English technical terms, then refine requirements through short follow-ups. You request English documentation and favor compact explanations, useful names, and diagrams that help colleagues understand the system.

evidence.quote: quick question：pandas read_csv 的 dtype=str 跟 converters 哪個比較適合處理混亂的欄位？
這個 test 名稱太長了，改短一點但要看得出在測什麼
幫我寫一份 README，說明本機怎麼跑 Dagster、怎麼跑 test、環境變數有哪些，英文
回顧一下這兩個月：從 CSV parser 到 dbt 到 Dagster，幫我整理成一頁的架構說明，給新同事看

dimensions.title: From ingestion to orchestration
dimensions.summary: Your requests span Python CSV handling, SQL/dbt transformations, warehouse modeling, and Dagster automation. You also ask for packaging, strict typing, automated checks, and reproducible dependencies, extending attention beyond individual pipeline components.

evidence.quote: 好，那幫我改成 converters，然後補一個 test 確認 leading zero 不會被吃掉

幫我寫一個 sensor，raw bucket 有新檔案就觸發 staging 的 asset
CI 用 GitHub Actions 跑 ruff、mypy 跟 pytest，matrix 跑 3.12 和 3.13
好，CI 改成 uv sync --frozen，謝謝

dimensions.title: Correct data, protected data
dimensions.summary: You repeatedly focus on precision, duplicate handling, data invariants, and operational quality checks. Privacy appears throughout your requested designs, from email masking and safe logs to notifications and automated mart restrictions.

evidence.quote: 這個 parser 可以不要用 float 嗎？金額一定要 Decimal，謝謝
如果同一個檔案被丟兩次，要 idempotent，不能重複寫入
通知內容不要帶任何客戶資料，只有 table 名稱和數量
寫一個 macro 掃描 meta pii: true 的欄位，如果出現在 mart 層就讓 build fail

dimensions.title: Learn, compare, apply
dimensions.summary: You use focused conceptual questions to connect unfamiliar features to the pipeline you are building. Your requests move from materialization and asset concepts toward source-dependent strategy choices, consistent typing conventions, and manageable lint strictness.

evidence.quote: 麻煩解釋一下 dbt 的 ephemeral 跟 view materialization 差在哪裡

traits.name: You want proof that checks can fail
traits.description: You repeatedly ask to see a failing test or deliberately invalid input rejected before trusting the implementation or safeguard.

evidence.quote: test 先跑一次確認會 fail，我想看到 red 再改 code
先寫 test 再寫 asset，這是我的習慣，麻煩照這個順序
這個 macro 的 test 怎麼寫？我想要先看到它擋下一個故意放錯的 model

traits.name: You turn privacy into engineering requirements
traits.description: You carry privacy constraints across ingestion, logs, notifications, and warehouse models, often asking for explicit enforcement.

evidence.quote: 能不能確認 log 裡面不會印出原始 email？我不想 PII 出現在任何 log

traits.name: You keep decision checkpoints
traits.description: You often ask to inspect a design, expected result, or error list before authorizing the next implementation step.

evidence.quote: 先不要寫 model，幫我列出 staging / intermediate / mart 三層要放什麼

traits.name: You specify what correctness means
traits.description: You make correctness concrete through precision rules, repeat-ingestion behavior, and warehouse invariants rather than relying on a successful run alone.

evidence.quote: 這個 parser 可以不要用 float 嗎？金額一定要 Decimal，謝謝

traits.name: You write for the next reader
traits.description: You repeatedly request English documentation that explains fields, local operation, troubleshooting, and architecture in a compact, usable form.
